DeVore Orangutan O/96 has moderate placement sensitivity — Wide-baffle design produces substantial bass energy that can overwhelm rooms smaller than 15 square metres. Needs breathing room — pull away from rear walls to let the presentation open up.
upgradeDirection: If you want to add clarity without losing the warmth that defines this system, a source upgrade (DAC or streamer) with better transient resolution is the gentlest move. Swapping the amplifier or speakers would shift the system's identity more fundamentally.

keyObservation: Your component choices suggest a preference for equipment emphasising **harmonic richness and tonal density and dynamic elasticity**. Denafrips Terminator II, Naim SuperNait 3, DeVore Orangutan O/96 share this design philosophy. The system shares a consistent harmonic density emphasis — this reinforces the system's identity.
